application.description: Primary Open Brain MCP server. Deno/Hono HTTP app exposing 4 MCP tools (capture_thought, search_thoughts, list_thoughts, thought_stats) over StreamableHTTP. Authenticates via x-brain-key header or ?key= query param. Intended for deployment as a Supabase Edge Function.
application.startup_hint: supabase functions deploy open-brain  OR  deno run --allow-net --allow-env server/index.ts

application.description: Self-hosted / Kubernetes variant of the core MCP server. Replaces Supabase client with a direct PostgreSQL+pgvector connection pool. Same 4 MCP tools and Hono HTTP layer as the primary server.

Background batch worker (Supabase Edge Function) that drains the entity_extraction_queue table, calls an LLM to extract entities and relationships, and upserts into the knowledge-graph tables. Triggered via HTTP GET/POST with optional ?limit= and ?dry_run= params.
Extended MCP server that adds Work Operating Model tools (goals, projects, decisions, check-ins) on top of a Supabase backend. Deployed as a Supabase Edge Function.

Knowledge-graph MCP server (OB-Graph). Exposes 10 graph tools (create_node, create_edge, search_nodes, get_neighbors, traverse_graph, find_path, update_node, delete_node, delete_edge, list_edge_types) over Hono+StreamableHTTP.
Express HTTP server for the Repo Learning Coach full-stack app. Serves the React/Vite SPA and exposes REST endpoints for lesson progress, quiz answers, artifacts, and Supabase content sync.

cli.description: CLI script to parse a ChatGPT conversations.json export and bulk-import it into the Open Brain Supabase database.
CLI script to walk an Obsidian vault directory and import all Markdown notes into Open Brain.
CLI script to parse a Perplexity AI conversation export and import it into Open Brain.
CLI script that re-embeds thoughts using a locally running Ollama model instead of the default OpenRouter embeddings.
CLI script to generate SVG/HTML infographics from retrieved Open Brain thoughts.
Node.js CLI script to parse a Google Takeout activity JSON export and import it into Open Brain.
Node.js CLI script to import a Grok (xAI) conversation export into Open Brain.
Node.js CLI script to parse an Instagram data export and import posts/captions into Open Brain.
Node.js CLI script to parse an X/Twitter archive export and import tweets into Open Brain.
Node.js CLI script to import Blogger journal entries into Open Brain.
Node.js CLI script to export all thoughts from Open Brain to a local JSON backup file.
Node.js CLI script to backfill content fingerprints on existing thoughts for deduplication.
Node.js CLI script to identify and delete duplicate thoughts based on content fingerprints.
Node.js CLI script to re-process existing thoughts through the metadata enrichment pipeline.
Node.js CLI script to backfill the 'type' metadata field on existing thoughts.
Node.js CLI script to backfill sensitivity classification on existing thoughts.
Node.js CLI script to generate wiki-style entity pages from the knowledge graph.
Node.js CLI script to classify/type knowledge graph edges using an LLM.
Node.js CLI orchestration script that compiles per-entity wikis into a unified knowledge base document.
Node.js CLI script to synthesize structured wiki content from raw thoughts and entity data.
Node.js CLI script to backfill wiki synthesis for Gmail-imported contacts.
TypeScript script to pull Gmail history and import email threads into Open Brain.
Database migration runner for the Vercel+Neon variant.
Helper script to convert large binary/document files into text chunks suitable for Open Brain ingestion.
Helper script to package converted file content into client-ready export format.

api.description: MCP protocol endpoint. All routes handled by a single Hono catch-all that delegates to StreamableHTTPTransport. Auth via x-brain-key header or ?key= param.
Next.js App Router API route for capturing a new thought via HTTP POST.
Next.js App Router API route that exposes the MCP endpoint for the Vercel+Neon deployment.
Next.js App Router webhook handler for incoming Telegram bot messages (grammy).
Health-check endpoint for the Vercel+Neon deployment.
HTTP endpoint for the entity extraction worker. Accepts GET/POST with optional ?limit= and ?dry_run= query params.
OB-Graph MCP endpoint — Hono app exposing knowledge-graph tools over StreamableHTTP.

library.description: Importable TypeScript module demonstrating the schema-aware routing pattern. Not a standalone server — meant to be embedded or studied as a reference implementation for multi-table writes driven by LLM-extracted metadata.
Importable TypeScript module implementing adaptive capture with LLM-based gating/classification before writing to the database.
Shared utility helpers (type guards, coercions) used internally by the entity-extraction-worker Edge Function.
Shared LLM model constants for the entity-extraction-worker (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic variants).
Reusable ESM library providing core memory operations (read/write/search) used by the thought-enrichment scripts.
Reusable ESM library with regex/heuristic patterns for classifying thought sensitivity.

primary_entry.reason: The canonical Open Brain MCP server. It is the single deployable unit that all AI clients (Claude Desktop, claude.ai, any MCP-compatible client) connect to. Every other entry point is either a variant of this server or a one-time data migration/enrichment script that feeds data into the database this server exposes.
